macros.name: newtheoremstyle

arg.snippet: newtheoremstyle{${1:name}}{${2:space above}}{${3:space below}}{${4:body font}}{${5:indent amount}}{${6:head font}}{${7:head punctuation}}{${8:space after head}}{${9:head spec}}

macros.doc: The \newtheoremstyle command is designed to provide, through a relatively simple interface, control over the style aspects that are most commonly changed.

macros.name: swapnumbers
macros.doc: A \swapnumbers command allows theorem numbers to be swapped to the front of the theorem headings.

envs.name: proof
envs.doc: The proof environment is never numbered, and has a \qed at the end, which makes it inconvenient to use \newtheorem for defining it.
